events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: The Green Bay Packers rattled and robbed Jay Cutler and backup tight end Tom Crabtree scored on a fake field goal in the second quarter of a 23-10 victory over the Chicago Bears at Lambeau Field on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers force 7 sacks, 4 INTs, knock off Bears

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: C.J. Spiller scored twice and had 123 yards rushing in sparking the Buffalo Bills' 35-17 rout over the Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spiller helps Bills bounce back, blast Chiefs

headlines.description: Adam "Pacman" Jones' returned Cleveland's first punt 81 yards for a touchdown Sunday, and Andy Dalton matched his career high with three touchdown passes, leading the Cincinnati Bengals to a 34-27 victory in their one-sided rivalry.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton throws 3 TDs, helps Bengals by Browns

headlines.description: Adam Vinatieri made a 53-yard field goal with 8 seconds left Sunday to give Andrew Luck and Indianapolis a 23-20 victory over Minnesota.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vinatieri FG gives Luck, Pagano first Colts win

headlines.description: Reggie Bush ran for 172 yards and two touchdowns Sunday, and the Miami Dolphins won a home opener for the first time since 2005 by beating the Oakland Raiders 35-13.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bush, Tannehill help Dolphins drop Raiders

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Backup quarterback Kevin Kolb threw for one touchdown and ran for another, Stephen Gostkowski missed a potential winning field goal in the final seconds, and the Arizona Cardinals upset the New England Patriots 20-18 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals stun Patriots as Hernandez KO'd

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New York Giants

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw for 510 yards, and Andre Brown's 2-yard run with 31 seconds left lifted the New York Giants from a 14-point deficit to a wild 41-34 victory Sunday over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eli rallies Giants, throws for 510 yards vs. Bucs

headlines.description: Michael Vick scored on a 1-yard TD run with 1:55 left, helping the Philadelphia Eagles overcome a slew of turnovers to beat the Baltimore Ravens 24-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles upend Ravens despite slew of TOs

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 253 yards and ran for a career-high 71 yards as the Carolina Panthers defeated New Orleans 35-27 on Sunday to hand the Saints their first 0-2 start since 2007.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers send Saints to 0-2 start

headlines.description: Arian Foster ran for 110 yards and a touchdown, Ben Tate added 74 yards and two scores and the Texans dominated from the opening kickoff in a 27-7 win at Jacksonville on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foster, Tate help Texans run Jags into ground

events.name: Washington Redskins at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Sam Bradford threw for 310 yards and three touchdowns and Danny Amendola caught 15 passes for 160 yards in rallying the St. Louis Rams to a 31-28 win over Robert Griffin III and the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson injured as pass attack boosts Rams

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch ran for 122 yards and a 3-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter, Seattle's special teams came up with two huge first-quarter plays that led to 10 points, and the Seahawks beat the Dallas Cowboys 27-7 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks use stifling defense to roll Cowboys

events.name: New York Jets at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger passed for 275 yards and two touchdowns, and the Pittsburgh Steelers smothered the New York Jets in the second half of a 27-10 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big Ben (2 TDs), Steelers handle Jets

events.name: Tennessee Titans at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Dante Rosario had three touchdown catches for the first time in his NFL career and San Diego's defense harassed Jake Locker all afternoon as the Chargers beat the Tennessee Titans for the ninth straight time, 38-10 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rosario's three TDs lead Chargers past Titans

headlines.description: San Francisco's stingy defense denied Matthew Stafford another milestone, Vernon Davis caught touchdown passes of 21 and 23 yards from Alex Smith, and the 49ers beat the Detroit Lions 27-19 on Sunday night in a September showdown of NFC powers.
headlines.shortLinkText: QB Smith solid as Niners dismiss visiting Lions

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw his 100th career touchdown pass, Roddy White had 102 yards receiving and the Atlanta Falcons defeated the Denver Broncos and error-prone quarterback Peyton Manning 27-21 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons feast on Manning's picks to top Broncos
